definitions.explanation: Sending something onward to a different destination. Used for mail, email, phone calls, and data.

examples.japanese: メールを{転送|てんそう}した。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{後|ご}の{郵便|ゆうびん}{転送|てんそう}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I applied for mail forwarding after moving.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}を{担当者|たんとうしゃ}に{転送|てんそう}しますので、{少々|しょうしょう}お{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: I'll transfer your call to the person in charge, so please hold for a moment.

notes:
Used across multiple contexts: postal mail, email, phone calls, and digital data.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メールを{転送|てんそう}する (to forward an email)
- {電話|でんわ}を{転送|てんそう}する (to transfer a call)
- {郵便|ゆうびん}{転送|てんそう} (mail forwarding)
- {自動|じどう}{転送|てんそう} (auto-forwarding)
- データを{転送|てんそう}する (to transfer data)

USAGE NOTE:
For postal mail, the Japan Post Office offers a free {転送|てんそう} service that redirects mail from your old address to your new one for one year after moving. This is a very common practical use of the word.
